physics_notes:
# bamboo_lid_box

Built from existing undistorted source frames; offline modeling, not online estimation. No new capture.

Body and lid are independent rigid parts. Contact walls retain container cavity; contents not fused to shell.

Geometry and placement: size is [X,Y,Z] metres; placement is bottom centre in supplied metric WORLD. Counter supports use layout heights (prep 0.955 m; sink 1.025 m); floor 0. Sources and raw depth samples are in ../measurements.json. Transparent/specular depth outliers are not accepted as dimensions. Shape details, hidden backs, thickness, density, mass, friction, and unactuated joint limits are priors. Approximate placement uncertainty 3–5 cm; depth scale reported about 4%.

Review: source crops retain exact frame IDs. Calibrated static cameras use original intrinsics/poses and world placement. Held/demo views are evidence only; static render cannot explain hand motion. No quantitative silhouette accuracy claimed.

Source label colours retain capture lighting. Material roughness and fine normals are explicit priors; bamboo micrograin was synthesized from the reference crop. Fine labels are photo crops, not newly invented text.

Simulation: Blender has active compound rigid bodies and supported constraints, initially disabled for inspection; enable rigidbody_world for simulation. Lift-off parts have no artificial slide joint. The scene has no floor/support fixture. Use collision map to assemble compound bodies in your simulator; GLB carries visuals and names, while JSON supplies physics/joints. Collision margin 0.4 mm. No friction/mass calibration or dynamic task evaluation performed.

Run Blender 4.2 headlessly with `blender -b -P build.py`. Inputs: config.json and textures/photo_basecolor.jpg. The script regenerates meshes, PBR microtexture and render files. Build/render wall time is recorded in model.json; excludes measurement/modeling time.
